definitions.explanation: A common viral infection of the upper respiratory tract.

notes:
{風邪|かぜ} refers to the common cold.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {風邪|かぜ}を{引|ひ}く: to catch a cold
- {風邪|かぜ}が{治|なお}る: to recover from a cold
- {風邪気味|かぜぎみ}: feeling a bit under the weather

NOTE:
Written with kanji {風邪}, though the reading is the same as {風|かぜ} (wind).
